user.title: Daily goals
user.description: Notifications and the reward for a perfect day. After this step, add your goals with **Add goal** on the integration page.

data_description.name: Device name and prefix of the entity IDs. One entry per person, for example.
data_description.notify_services: `notify.*` actions that receive a message when a goal is achieved, for example the mobile app. Leave empty for no push notifications.
data_description.persistent_notification: Also show the achievements in Home Assistant. They are dismissed at midnight.
data_description.notification_images: Mobile app only: a different fun picture every day (foxes, cats, dogs, ducks, robots, landscapes) from free online services.
data_description.open_on_tap: Mobile app only: dashboard path opened when the notification is tapped, for example `/lovelace/health`.
data_description.perfect_day_reward: Optional. Sent when every goal of the day is achieved, for example "An episode of your favourite series".

abort.already_configured: A set of goals with this name already exists.

data_description.notify_services: `notify.*` actions that receive a message when a goal is achieved, for example the mobile app. Leave empty for no push notifications.
data_description.persistent_notification: Also show the achievements in Home Assistant. They are dismissed at midnight.
data_description.notification_images: Mobile app only: a different fun picture every day (foxes, cats, dogs, ducks, robots, landscapes) from free online services.
data_description.open_on_tap: Mobile app only: dashboard path opened when the notification is tapped, for example `/lovelace/health`.
data_description.perfect_day_reward: Optional. Sent when every goal of the day is achieved, for example "An episode of your favourite series".

user.title: Add a goal
user.description: Pick the sensor to follow and the target to reach every day.

data_description.source_entity: Any entity with a numeric state: sensor, number, input number or counter.
data_description.name: Shown on the card and in the notifications. Default: the name of the sensor.
data_description.target: The value to reach (or not to exceed) every day.
data_description.direction: Whether the value must reach the target or stay at or under it.
data_description.daily_reset: Which values count every new day.
data_description.complete_with: Optional. The goal counts as achieved only when this other goal is achieved at the same time (for example systolic and diastolic blood pressure).

reward_section.name: Reward
reward_section.description: Points, prize and notification for this goal.

data_description.points: Added to the points of the day and to the total when the goal is achieved.
data_description.reward: Optional. A prize you give yourself, shown in the notification and on the card, for example "A square of dark chocolate".
data_description.notify: Send a notification when the goal is achieved.

appearance.name: Appearance
appearance.description: How the goal looks on the card.

data_description.color: Color of the progress ring. Default: a color of the card palette.
data_description.unit: Default: the unit of the sensor.
data_description.waiting_text: Shown on the card until today's value arrives, for example "Step on the scale!". Default: "Waiting for today's value".

options.below: Stay at or under the target

options.new_value: Wait for a new value (daily counters, measurements, tests)
options.current_value: Use the current value (averages and trends)

set_statistics.name: Set statistics
set_statistics.description: Sets the streak, the best streak and the total points by hand, for example to carry them over from another setup. Target any sensor of the set of goals.

streak.name: Streak
streak.description: Perfect days in a row, today included if it is already perfect.

best_streak.name: Best streak
best_streak.description: Longest streak so far (never lower than the streak).
